title: Love & Care
description:
It's important to keep your animals happy and well-cared for. Here's some tools to help you out.

The Grooming Brush and Brushing Post allow you to groom your animals, keeping them clean, happy, and healthy.

The Feeding Trough allows animals to feed themselves when they get hungry. Just don't let it run empty!

Without a nest, your chickens will lay their eggs anywhere they feel like. Put a Chicken Nest in their enclosure, and it will collect the eggs in one place for you, held safely so they do not despawn.

The Farm Magnifying Glass allows you to see a given animal's health stats.

And the Farm Ledger will you show you a given animal's genetics.
